entities.summary: Heidi Andersson is a Swedish armwrestler. She has won the World Championships in armwrestling eleven times. She was born in the locality of Ensamheten, Storuman Municipality, and is married to Swedish biathlete Björn Ferry, with whom she has a son, Dante Andersson Ferry, born 19 July 2011.
